headwords: giết gà dùng dao mổ trâu

flags.why: Calling a driver “giặc lái” is derogatory, so the colloquial tag alone does not adequately warn the learner.
This is an explanation of the idiom's literal image, not a separate established meaning.
The example defines giốc instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Giai điệu kết thúc ở âm giốc. = The melody ends on the giốc note.

flags.why: The makeup sense is marked as dated in the [Vietnamese dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-gi%E1%BB%93i), but has no currency warning here.
The example explains the time period instead of showing the expression in use.
flags.fix: Chúng tôi đến nơi vào giờ Ngọ. = We arrived at the hour of the Horse.
